svg.title: North Western Railway streaming pipeline — swappable Kafka / Kinesis backends
svg.desc: Engine telemetry is produced to two swappable stream backends, side by side: a three-partition Kafka topic on Confluent Cloud (Avro) and a parallel three-shard AWS Kinesis Data Stream (JSON). A lever in the live view picks which backend the live view shows. A Snowflake Sink Connector reads the Kafka topic into Snowflake for analytics; an always-on ECS Fargate task taps both backends and pushes live readings to the web view over Server-Sent Events. Analytics queries round-trip from the web view through the ECS task to Snowflake.
